answer_1.quote: Chart summarization requires faithfully extracting quantitative data and describing them using natural language.

answer_2.quote: n-gram based metrics such as BLEU, or learned metrics such as BLEURT rely only on gold references.

answer_3.quote: CHATS-CRITIC uses DePlot and PaLM-2 (L) with Chain-of-thought for the entailment model.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 60 different charts from Chart-To-Text (Statista) test set and surveyed the Entailment, Relevance, and Grammaticality ... on the sentence and summary level.
answer_4.guideline: for each sentence we ask the rater if is (1) entailed, (2) relevant, and (3) grammatically correct.
